data.m_Name: Desecrated Statue of the First Mountain King - Victory
data.EventNameOverride: Desecrated Statue of the First Mountain King
data.encounterText:
With the wild pack of goblins vanquished and victory ringing through the air, you survey the aftermath of your hard-fought battle. Amidst the scattered remnants of the goblin horde, you find pieces of the golden statue. The voice of the King fills your mind:

"Those pesky goblins have been tainting my sacred halls for far too long. 'Bout time someone put 'em in their place!" 

"May your hearts be as sturdy as the stone, and your spirits as unyielding as the forge. Go forth, with the Blessing of the Mountain."
data.promptToSelectCharacter: Who will listen to his pleas?

EventPrefabReference.Path: Island Hex Pieces\Events\Broken Statue of the First Mountain King

eventOptions.title: Accept
eventOptions.description: Take the Blessing.

eventActions.activationText: You are filled with a fiery passion for battle and the frothy embrace of ale. It burns within your very being, igniting your spirit with a fierce determination and an insatiable thirst for both victory and merriment.

data.m_Name: Desecrated Statue of the First Mountain King Battle
data.encounterText: A band of raucous Goblins revel in their ill-gotten gains. These mischievous creatures, driven by their insatiable greed, have amassed a collection of treasures that sparkled and gleam in the dim torchlight. Their celebration echoes through the caverns, filling the air with a cacophony of cackles, guttural laughter, and discordant songs. The goblins, with their hunched forms and gleaming eyes, danced in a frenzy of glee, their long, spindly fingers clutching their newfound wealth. These are undoubtedly the culprits who desecrated the statue of the Mountain King.
data.promptToSelectCharacter: Who will listen to his pleas?

EventPrefabReference.Path: Island Hex Pieces\Events\The Burning Hearts of Demons

eventOptions.title: Fight
eventOptions.description: Destroy these goblins in the name of the First Mountain King

eventActions.activationText: At your approach, the goblins' grins twist into snarls, as they brandish their crude weapons with a savage glee.
As you behold the tumultuous revelry and the wild gleam in the goblins' eyes, a seed of doubt takes root within your heart. Perhaps the honor of a statue isn't worth all this.

data.m_Name: Desecrated Statue of the First Mountain King
data.encounterText:
In the heart of these ancient ruins, you stumble upon a sight as awe-inspiring as it is tragic - a statue of a dwarven king, sculpted with meticulous precision from pure gold. Once resplendent and majestic, the statue is now a hollow echo of its former grandeur. It bares the telltale signs of looting, the handiwork of goblins all too clear in the crude scars and scratches that marred its surface.

The once-noble features of the dwarven king were missing, the statue's head severed from its body. It lay at the base of the statue, its golden eyes gazing up at the heroes with a strange sort of melancholy. As you approach, a voice echoes out from the decapitated head:

"Well, well, what have we here? A ragtag bunch of adventurers? Come to witness the sorry state of this once majestic form? 'Tis I, the great Mountain King, turned into naught but a pile of rubble by those wretched goblins!"

"I demand justice, I say!"

"Retrieve me, in all my golden glory, and return me to the halls of my ancestors. Let those goblins quake with fear at the sight of the First Mountain King once more!"
data.promptToSelectCharacter: Who will listen to his pleas?

EventPrefabReference.Path: Island Hex Pieces\Events\Broken Statue of the First Mountain King

eventOptions.title: Accept
eventOptions.description: Bring justice to the gold lootin' goblins.

eventActions.activationText:
You agree to help and dwarvish laughter rings in your ears. 

"They will rue the day!"

eventOptions.title: Loot
eventOptions.description: Take what's left.

eventActions.activationText: You pick up the Gold Statue Head thoughtfully. "Oh, You wouldn't dare!" The voice muffles as you stuff the Gold Statue Head deep into your bag.

data.encounterText:
There stands a man before you as chilling as the frosty winds of Frostwrought Mountain. A towering figure, with a burlap sack pulled down tightly over his head and a horrifying apron, spotted with deep crimson stains, wrapped around his broad chest.

"Good eve," he rasps, his voice like gravel and smoke. "Are you in need of sustenance?"

The man extends a gnarled hand, presenting a trio of dishes, each more horrifying than the last.

First, a bubbling, steaming cauldron of a soup, its murky surface breaking to reveal human hands, fingers curled as though grasping for escape. Next, a plate of what seems to be oversized cockroaches, their bodies crisp and their wings crackling as if recently deep-fried. And finally, a platter bearing a single, massive, dark purple tentacle. It twitches, even in its cooked state, muscles rippling under its suckered skin, making the dish appear as though it was still alive.
data.encounterPossibleResultsText: The man remains silent, watching with disturbing patience for you to choose.
data.promptToSelectCharacter: Who will listen to his pleas?

eventOptions.title: Crusty Cockroach
eventOptions.description: The cockroach, easily as long as a dagger, gleams in the light. Its chitinous shell is a deep brown, speckled with a dusting of spices.

eventActions.activationText: The initial crunch of the shell is followed by a burst of flavors, wildly contrasting the horrifying appearance of the dish. There is a nutty sweetness to it, counteracted by a savory note that is strangely pleasing. The texture is akin to a perfectly roasted poultry, the shell providing a sharp, crispy contrast to the succulent flesh within.

eventOptions.title: Hand Soup
eventOptions.description: A dark, brooding broth, the soup has an ethereal quality, swirls of steam dance above it. Peeking out of the opaque depths are the human hands, boiled down to the bone, the eerie spectacle almost hypnotic.

eventActions.activationText: The broth is rich and hearty, filled with flavors of earthy roots, a hint of the sea, and something slightly metallic. It is, to your surprise, pleasantly palatable, offering an unusual array of tastes and sensations. The bones themselves are another experience entirely. Crunchy and delicate, they give way easily, revealing the tenderness of the marrow within. It is soft and rich, with a creamy, almost buttery texture that belied its grim origins.

eventOptions.title: Twitching Tentacle
eventOptions.description: The tentacle's slick surface is adorned with rows of suckers. Every few seconds, it twitches, the muscle memory of the creature it once belonged to asserting itself in death.

eventActions.activationText:
It is chewy, the texture similar to calamari but somehow more intense, more primal. The flavor that exploded in your mouth is unexpectedly delicate – an amalgamation of the sea and the earth, a unique savoriness tinged with a briny sweetness.

The twitching sensation is a bit disconcerting but, remarkably, it doesn't detract from the experience. It felt almost alive in your mouth, a strange dance that adds an unexpected layer of texture to the meal.

data.encounterText:
In the flickering light, you behold a colossal barrier, a monument to the dwarves' rocky resilience. Hewn directly from solid bedrock and crafted into the stone visage of a bearded dwarf. A gruff voice calls out at your approach:

"Aye. And who might ye be? Ye look no dwarf to me."

Dwarven sentries are notorious for their lack of hospitality to those not of their own. Best to play the part.
data.promptToSelectCharacter: Who will convince the sentry?

eventOptions.title: Act
eventOptions.description: Do your best impression of a dwarf.

eventActions.activationText:
"An' just what is the meaning of this?" [name] thunders, [his] words ringing out with surprising power. "Aren't we all children of the stone? By the spirits of the forge, ye should be ashamed, treating kin in such a manner!"

The dwarven sentry quitely apologizes and allows you safe passage.

"Oh. Aye, I'm definitely a dwarf. I be short and angry!" [name] shouts in pretend indignation.

The ground beneath you begins to rumble ominously. The massive stone beard of the dwarf statue shifts, the intricately carved mouth slides open to reveal a gaping chasm. Suddenly, a torrent of molten steel cascades forth from the dwarf's mouth, the bright, liquid fire spilling out onto the ground before you!

data.encounterText: Deep within the winding tunnels of the ancient dwarven halls, you discover a chamber of remarkable grandeur. Its heart holds a dwarven sarcophagus, a marvel of stonemasonry that commands your awe and reverence. Intricately chiseled from solid granite, it is adorned with a cascade of dwarven runes, their angular forms whispering tales of valor and lineage etched into the cold stone.

eventOptions.title: Loot
eventOptions.description: Remove the stone lid and take what you can.

eventActions.activationText:
You push hard against the heavy stone lid and it slowly begins to open.

Resting reverently in the hands of the long dead dwarf is an object that seems untouched by the passage of time: a finely crafted dwarven horn.

You push against the heavy stone lid with all your might, but its of no use.

The sarcophagus will remain undisturbed.

eventOptions.title: Pay Respect
eventOptions.description: Whatever this soul did in life, they deserve the peace of death.

eventActions.activationText:
As you place your hand on the Tomb in reverence, a sudden loud click, shatters the silence. The sarcophagus lid shifts and opens, releasing a cloud of ancient dust. 

Resting reverently in the hands of the long dead dwarf is an object that seems untouched by the passage of time: a finely crafted dwarven horn.

data.encounterText:
On a worn table lays a spellbook, its pages yellowed with age, its spine fragile and cracked. Its cover was worn and tattered, suggestive of the countless fingers that had turned its pages, and the innumerable years it has weathered. Parts of the book had been damaged or lost over time, leaving behind an incomplete narrative, like a puzzle missing several pieces:

"---- there are tales woven with the threads of glory and tragedy alike. Such is the tale of Edwin an unremarkable lad, a mere acolyte of the most basic magics. His journey to fame was as surprising as it was sudden ---- enchantment granted him immense power by ---- a steep price that Edwin willingly paid for the allure of newfound abilities ---- His demonstrations of power quickly catapulted him into fame, attracting vast crowds eager to witness his spectacular displays of magic. Yet ---- The climax of Edwin's tragic tale occurred on a grand stage where he attempted to manifest an impressive display ---- In summary, Edwin's tale is a stark warning about the dangers of unchecked ambition and the dire consequences of misusing power. Infact, only a fool ----"

The rest of the page is illegible. However, instructions to cast Edwin's Enchantment are perfectly clear on the page beside it.
data.promptToSelectCharacter: Who will investigate the enchantment?

eventOptions.title: Cast
eventOptions.description: Attempt to cast the enchantment.

eventActions.activationText:
[name] begins reciting the incantation, [his] voice steady, [his] gaze focused. The words fill the chamber, imbued with an ancient power.

As [he] finishes, [he] feels a tingle of energy stirring within [him], like a flame sparked from the strike of a flint. It builds gradually, an inner warmth growing brighter, more intense. It is [his] life force, [his] very essence, being drawn forth, called upon to fuel [his] magic..

[name] begins reciting the incantation, [his] voice steady, [his] gaze focused. The words fill the chamber, imbued with an ancient power.

But instead of a burgeoning glow, there is only a fizzling spark. The warmth that was supposed to well up within [him] never came. Instead, a cold numbness spreads through [his] veins. [his] heart pounding in [his] chest, fear pricking [him] like a thousand icy needles.

eventOptions.title: Leave
eventOptions.description: You think better of fleeting fame.

data.encounterText: A massive Elder Tree grows here. Its giant body formed not only of wood but of living stone and ore. All around it life seems to flourish as if it were the very heart of the forest. You stumble upon an entity as old as time itself: the Elder Tree. It stands regal and magnificent, its massive trunk adorned with the etchings of time, its gnarled boughs stretching out like the arms of a benevolent giant. The air around it hums with an ancient magic, a soothing hum that permeates your senses and seems to soften the edges of the world. A sense of profound tranquility seems to blanket the area around the tree, a bubble of peace amidst the trials of your journey. The tree's aura washes over you, melting away your fatigue, soothing your aches, and calming your mind.

eventOptions.title: Rest
eventOptions.description: Enjoy the tranquility the Elder Tree brings.

eventActions.activationText: You gratefully settle beneath the tree's boughs, your body sinking into the carpet of moss that had grown around the tree's base. As you do, you can feel the lingering energy from the tree seeping into you, mending your wounds and restoring your strength. It is as if the Elder Tree is sharing its vitality, a sacred bond forged between you.

eventOptions.title: Eat
eventOptions.description: Take fruit from the Elder Tree.

eventActions.activationText: As you bite into the radiant fruit, memories not your own flood your mind. You taste the crispness of the dawn, the warmth of countless suns, the whisper of falling rain. You experience the changing seasons, the passage of time, and the endless dance of life and death that the tree had borne witness to. You taste joy and sorrow, the timeless struggle of the forest, and the serene acceptance of the natural cycle.

data.encounterText:
A colossal axe swings like a pendulum with a force that belies the absence of any hand to wield it, a sentinel denying you passage. It's clear an enchantment lies upon it, old magic, fashioned to keep intruders at bay.

Someone will have to disrupt the magic to ensure safe passage.
data.encounterPossibleResultsText: Who will attempt to disrupt the magic?

eventOptions.title: Disrupt
eventOptions.description: Use your knowledge of the arcane to dispel the enchantment.

eventActions.activationText:
[name] whispers the words of an incantation.

Suddenly, the axe's swing began to slow, its unerring rhythm disrupted by magic. The once unstoppable axe comes to a complete halt, hanging motionless in the air. The path is clear.

[name] whispers the words of an incantation.

For a moment, it seems as though the axe slows in its swing. But then, with a resonant hum, it continues its rhythmic arc, the powerful magic refusing to yield.

data.encounterText:
Rising from the earth like the tooth of some gargantuan beast, an obelisk crafted entirely from limestone, ancient and weathered stands proud and defiant. 

Upon the weather-beaten stone, a single white rune is etched, glowing softly in the dying light of the day. Its luminescence pulsing gently, in rhythm with the heart of the world. Even from a distance, you can sense its potent magic, a beacon drawing you towards it.
data.promptToSelectCharacter: Who will use Obelisk's power?
data.characterSelectedText: [name] approaches the Obelisk anxiously awaiting the blessing it will bring.

eventOptions.title: Activate the blessing
eventOptions.description: Press the palm of your hand upon the obelisk.

eventActions.activationText: [name] extends [his] hand, [his] fingertips barely brushing against the cool, rugged surface. Instantly, a pulse of energy courses through [him], [his] minds expanding, their senses sharpening. A sudden clarity washes over [him], like a veil lifting from their eyes.

eventOptions.title: Heal from the obelisk
eventOptions.description: Draw the energy from the limestone obelisk.

eventActions.activationText: [name] extends [his] hand, [his] fingertips barely brushing against the cool, rugged surface. The magic flows into [him], warm and invigorating. [his] wounds knit together, [his] fatigue washed away like dust in the rain. Each pulse of the rune is a surge of revitalization, a surge of healing energy that left [him] standing taller, [his] body whole and [his] spirit unbroken.

data.encounterText: With a resounding crash, the final blow is struck. The Scarecrow lets out a creaking groan that echoes through the still forest air, its luminescent eyes flickering once before fading out. It collapses back into its initial position, once more an ordinary sentinel amidst the pumpkins. Victorious, you once again turn your attention to the enchanted pumpkins.
data.promptToSelectCharacter: Dare to open the Cursed Chest?

eventOptions.title: Take
eventOptions.description: Claim an Enchanted Pumpkin for yourself.

eventActions.activationText: You reach out and pluck a large pumpkin from the vine. Its surface is warm to the touch, a subtle energy thrumming beneath the smooth rind.

data.encounterText: You stumble upon an unlikely sight: an Enchanted Pumpkin Patch, nestled amidst the wilderness. Vibrant pumpkins of all sizes dot the landscape, their rich orange hue glow like embers in the creeping shadows. At the heart of the patch, keeping a silent vigil, stands a towering scarecrow. Its form is grotesquely exaggerated, angular and ominous under the light, its eyes twin points of baleful luminescence in its shadowed face. Despite its ghastly appearance, a strange, palpable magic thrums in the air around it, tying it to the very life force of the pumpkin patch.
data.promptToSelectCharacter: Dare to open the Cursed Chest?

eventOptions.title: Take
eventOptions.description: Reach down and take a Pumpkin.

eventActions.activationText: As you reach out to pluck a particularly large pumpkin, a sudden grip, cold and iron-hard, seizes your shoulder. You spin around, coming face to face with the scarecrow. Its eyes now blaze with an unnatural light, the silent guardian brought to life.

eventOptions.title: Leave
eventOptions.description: As enticing as it seems, some treasures are not meant to be taken.

eventActions.activationText: A sense of unease lingers in the air, the silence of the scarecrow's ominous presence. You leave the enchanted pumpkins behind.

eventOptions.title: Activate
eventOptions.description: Grants [o1a1_status].

data.encounterText: A Wild Boar, powerfully built and grim-eyed, is caught in a thorny snare. The thick Bristlethorn, is tough as twisted iron and studded with wicked thorns that dig deep into the boar's hide. Every movement the boar makes only seems to make the situation worse. The thorns bite deeper into its flesh, drawing forth beads of crimson that seep into the rich, damp earth. It thrashes and grunts in raw, unfiltered fear and pain, its eyes wild with the primitive instinct of a creature trapped and in distress.

eventOptions.title: Help
eventOptions.description: Attempt to free the boar.

eventActions.activationText:
With a swift, precise stroke, you cut through the thorny vine. The tension in the boar's body eases as the vine's grip lessens. The boar stumbles, then rights itself, its eyes wide.

The boar grunts, a low, rumbling sound that seems almost... grateful. You turn to leave, but a rustle behind you gives you pause.


Turning, you find the boar following you, its eyes fixed on you with something akin to loyalty. It seems the beast, in its own wild, untamed way, has pledged its gratitude to you. You can't help but smile, feeling a strange sense of companionship.

The vine, is stubbornly resistant to your blade, and refuses to yield. You quickly find yourself entangled in the thick vine as well. 

Swinging your blade desperately, you tumble free, gasping for breath, your hands and arms lined with shallow cuts.

With a heavy heart, you back away, sheathing your sword. The boar's panicked grunts echo in your ears, a bitter reminder of your failure.

eventOptions.title: Leave
eventOptions.description: The potential risks are too great.

eventActions.activationText: With a final, regretful look at the ensnared boar, [name] turns away, leaving the creature to its own fight.

data.encounterText: Suddenly, the ground beneath your feet quakes, and a deafening rumble echoes through the air. The peaceful serenity is shattered as a Volcanic Fissure explodes out of the earth, spewing forth a tide of molten rock and clouds of choking ash. As you look up, you see a shower of ash and embers falling towards you, a rain of fire and death. It will take only a moment for the molten rock to reach you, for the ash to smother your vision, your breath.
data.promptToSelectCharacter: Who will listen to her pleas?

eventOptions.title: React
eventOptions.description: Flee the cataclysmic eruption.

eventActions.activationText:
You weave a quick route through the tumult. A sudden leap over a freshly split chasm, a swift sidestep to avoid a falling, glowing rock, a roll to dodge a sudden burst of flame, each movement a testament to your quick thinking and agility.


Despite the heat and the smoke, you manage to make it to safer ground.

A large chunk of molten rock crashes to the ground nearby, causing a shockwave that knocks you off your feet. You stumble, trying to regain balance, but another tremor shakes the earth, and you fall.


Burning debris showers over you, bathing your body in searing heat.

data.encounterText:
A monolith stands like a sentinel, its massive form casting a long shadow over the sun-baked ground. Crafted from stone, weathered by time, it holds an imposing grandeur that dwarfs you.

It is unadorned, save for a singular, mysterious red rune that pulses at its heart, a vibrant contrast against the stone's gray expanse. It radiates an energy that thrums in your veins, a tangible vibration that resonates with your very being.
data.promptToSelectCharacter: Who will use the Monolith's power?
data.characterSelectedText: [name] approaches the Monolith anxiously awaiting the blessing it will bring.

eventOptions.title: Activate the blessing
eventOptions.description: Press the palm of your hand upon the monolith.

eventActions.activationText: The moment [name]'s hand makes contact with the monolith, a pulse of power surges through [him]. It feels as though [his] bones had turned to steel, [his] muscles to the cords of a tightly drawn bow. A feeling of raw, unadulterated strength fills [him], exhilarating and terrifying in equal measure.

eventOptions.title: Heal from the monolith
eventOptions.description: Draw the energy from the stone monolith.

eventActions.activationText: As [name]'s hand makes contact with the monolith, a warmth spreads from [his] fingertips, slowly inching its way up [his] arm and into [his] torso. As it permeated [his] body, it mends [his] wounds, and soothes [his] aches and pains.

eventOptions.title: Activate
eventOptions.description: Grants [o1a1_status].

data.encounterText:
Even amidst the fantastical nature of your journey, this particular fungus stands as a peculiar sight that draws you closer.

With a cautious curiosity, you move in for a closer look. It is a beautiful, delicate structure, its colors undulating in the ethereal light it emits. As you approach, the fungus seems to react, pulsating in a faster rhythm. Before you can pull back, it releases a sudden cloud of gas, the spores transforming from beautiful light to a dangerous, toxic fog.

Choking and gasping, you stagger back, but not before inhaling a dose of the poisonous spores.
data.promptToSelectCharacter: Who will listen to his pleas?

eventOptions.title: Resist
eventOptions.description: Do your best to weather the poison.

eventActions.activationText: [name] weathers the effects with little more than a grimace, [his] body quickly metabolizing the toxins. [he] looks shaken, [his] hand trembling slightly, but [he] holds on, jaw set in determination.
You collapse, and your body convulses as the toxin wreak havoc on your system.

data.encounterText: Finally, after what seems like an eternity of battling shadows, you emerge victorious. Your opponents lay strewn around you, their madness extinguished, replaced by a vacant stare. They had been driven to the edge by the ruby, the allure too strong, the pull too intoxicating. Carefully, you approach the pedestal, the Ruby pulsating with an ethereal light. The gem is yours for the taking, the fruits of a hard-won battle.

eventOptions.title: Take
eventOptions.description: You'll be the one to hold the Ruby.

eventActions.activationText: The warm, crimson light illuminates your face, casting an eerie glow over your features. Your eyes, usually warm and friendly, now mirror the fierce glow of the gem.

data.encounterText: This cave, previously draped in a sullen darkness, comes alive in a feverish light. The source of this illumination is a Giant Ruby, its radiant glow throwing a surreal dance of shadows on the stone walls. This gem is unlike any you had seen before, a pulsating heart in the belly of the earth, casting an allure that is both mesmerizing and disconcerting. It lays nestled atop a rock pedestal, its facets catching the light and fracturing it into a thousand crimson shards. You find yourself drawn to it, enraptured by its brilliance, your gaze reflected in its fiery depths. As you venture closer, your steps echo in the cavernous silence, you notice you are not alone. Other shadows move around you, dancing in the ruby's glow, creeping closer. Other adventurers, driven by the same allure, the same pursuit.

eventOptions.title: Take
eventOptions.description: Grab the ruby before someone else does.

eventActions.activationText:
A race begins, a frantic dash towards the tantalizing gem, a clash of desires igniting into a fierce competition. 

Once an object of mesmerizing beauty, the ruby becomes an ominous beacon, driving your opponents to madness. Their eyes glow with a dangerous light, a reflection of the gem's eerie illumination.

The serene atmosphere of the cavern is soon replaced with the sound of steel, the cries of battle, the frenzied desperation to reach the ruby first.

eventOptions.title: Leave
eventOptions.description: Pull yourself away from the allure of the ruby.

eventActions.activationText:
You feel the ruby's call, a whisper in the back of your mind, an urging to step forward and claim it.


Your gaze lingers on the gem, but you hold your ground, choosing caution over temptation.

data.encounterText: An enchanted fountain brimming with magic.

eventOptions.title: Drink
eventOptions.description: Restore health and mana.

eventActions.activationText: The cool water is sweet to the taste. You quickly feel refreshed.

data.encounterText: You hear jovial banter as you approach your supposed enemies. Perhaps this situation can be handled more delicately.

eventOptions.title: Persuade
eventOptions.description: Convince them you are allies not enemies.

eventActions.activationText: Your charismatic words make you new friends. You share food and drink as they tend to your wounds.
Your words falter as their faces darken, and they ready their weapons. The thought of an alliance angers them.

eventOptions.title: Fight
eventOptions.description: Straightforward battle is the best way to handle any situation.

data.encounterText: Your path is obstructed by an elaborate trap - a deadly Furnace of ancient design, capable of reducing even the sturdiest of adventurers to ash. From the numerous vents scattered across the floor, a sudden gush of heat erupts. Flames leap out with a voracious hunger, casting monstrous shadows that dance with a ferocious intensity. The path ahead is transformed into a river of fire, a fatal obstacle promising a fiery demise.
data.encounterPossibleResultsText: Who will attempt to disable the trap?

eventOptions.title: Disable
eventOptions.description: Brave the flames to disable the trap.

eventActions.activationText:
Each step [name] takes is calculated, each breath measured, every pulse of the flame anticipated. As if they are partners in an intimate dance, [name] and the flames move in sync, a mesmerizing spectacle of courage and skill.


At last, [he] reaches the trap's heart - a runic switch inscribed in the stone wall. [His] gloved hand reaching out, pressing it down with a firm pressure. The switch depresses with a satisfying click and suddenly, the flames retreat.

Gathering [his] cloak about [him], [name] takes a deep breath. With a sudden burst of speed, [he] dashes onto the treacherous path.


For a brief moment, it seems as if [he] succeeds. But then, the floor trembles beneath [him], and with a terrible roar, the stone eruptes, sending searing flames shooting into the air.


The firelight illuminates [his] desperate struggle, casting [his] twisted shadow onto the walls of the corridor.

data.encounterText: High above on a weathered timber tower, stands the solitary figure of a Goblin Ranger. His keen eyes scan the horizon with relentless vigilance, as his hand rests lightly on a bone horn that will, undoubtedly, summon hordes of goblins if it were to sound.
data.promptToSelectCharacter: Who will take action?

eventActions.activationText:
With an expert hand, [name] strikes at the Goblin from a distance. [His] breath stills, and for a moment, time seems to slow. [He] watches in silence, understanding the gravity of this shot.

It cuts through the still night air like a predator, racing towards its target. The goblin, ever watchful, turns at its soft whistling, his eyes widening in surprise.

But it is too late. [name] hits [his] mark, and with a muffled thud, the goblin collapses.

With an expert hand, [name] strikes at the Goblin from a distance. [His] breath stills, and for a moment, time seems to slow. [He] watches in silence, understanding the gravity of this shot.

It whistles, a thin, desperate sound that echoes in quietly, but veeres wide, missing its target.

The goblin, alert to the danger, spins around, his eyes catching the flash of the arrow as it skitters harmlessly off the wood of the tower. His wide-eyed surprise quickly turns into alarm, his hands darting to the bone horn at his side.

data.encounterText: In the end, the dwarven guard could not stand against you. With a final, valiant cry, the last of the dwarves falls. Silence fills the chamber, the only sound is your own labored breathing. The battle is over. You are victorious. Free to desecrate the sacred statue.

data.m_Name: Gold Statue of the First Mountain King
data.encounterText:
A statue, towering and grand, gleams with a lustre untouched by time. The magnificent statue, cast from pure gold, is a testament to the great skill and artistry of the dwarves. It is a glorious depiction of the <gold>First Mountain King</gold>, a legendary figure who laid the foundation for the dwarven kingdom.


You stand in awe, your gaze drawn to the intricately detailed armor, the steadfast expression, and the hefty hammers held firmly in the king's grip. The temptation of the golden figure is potent - it is a treasure that could secure fortunes, a prize that could change your life.

EventPrefabReference.Path: Island Hex Pieces\Events\Gold Statue of the First Mountain King

eventOptions.title: Steal
eventOptions.description: Give into temptation and take what you can.

eventActions.activationText:
You set about your dubious task and begin to pry loose the most valuable parts. 

Your efforts, however, do not go unnoticed. A gruff voice calls out, and dwarf guards, armed and armored, emerge from the shadows. The stern face under the helmet showed no surprise, only grim determination.

You pause awkwardly, tools poised mid-air, as the dwarf strides forward. "Ye dare desecrate the likeness of our first king!" he bellows, brandishing his axe menacingly. "Prepare to meet your end, robbers!"

eventOptions.title: Leave
eventOptions.description: You can't bring yourself to destroy this monument, the essence of a rich and proud dwarven culture.

data.encounterText:
The path ahead is a gauntlet of death. A monstrous contraption of grinding gears and rotating spindles, bristling with razor-sharp spikes. It spins with a deafening whir, a rhythmic cacophony that echoes ominously through the narrow passage. 

To pass through unscathed would require not only agility but also impeccable timing.
data.encounterPossibleResultsText: Who will attempt to disable the trap?

eventOptions.title: Disable
eventOptions.description: Dodge through the Trap to reach the kill switch.

eventActions.activationText:
[name]'s sharp eyes observe the cyclical rhythm of the trap. [his] lips move silently, counting the seconds, gauging the tempo of the spinning gears and deadly spines. Sweat drips from [his] brow, but [his] focus remains unbroken.


It is a perilous dance with death as [he] twirls and leaps, [his] body weaving through the rotating spikes with uncanny grace. Every movement is perfectly timed, every step carefully measured, until [he] finally reaches the killswitch.

Without a word, [name] springs forward, flitting between the spinning spikes with a dancer's grace. [he] seems to defy gravity, [his] body twisting and turning, contorting to fit the narrow openings between the deadly points.


But in one heart-stopping moment, [his] luck ran out. Perhaps [he] mistimed a step, or underestimated a spin. Perhaps the grinding gears shifted their rhythm just enough to throw [him] off. The specifics mattered little compared to the horrifying result.

data.encounterText: You stand around a Hulking Safe, its matte black exterior reflecting the dim torchlight. The solid steel structure is an intimidating sight, its austere facade is marked only by a complex locking mechanism, a series of concentric rings each adorned with cryptic symbols and numbers. No visible latch, no obvious keyhole. Just this unyielding enigma waiting to be solved. An opportunity for immense wealth, shrouded in an armor of cold, hardened steel.
data.promptToSelectCharacter: Who will try and crack the Heavy Safe?

eventOptions.title: Attempt
eventOptions.description: Try and crack the safe.

eventActions.activationText:
[name] gently rests [his] hands on the cold, unyielding metal, [his] fingers tracing the numbers on the dial. [his] ear presses against the steel surface, [he] begins to turn the dial slowly, listening for the subtle clicks and shifts that would guide [him].


The soft scrape of metal against metal echoed, a symphony of patience and precision. [name]'s focus was unyielding, his gaze locked onto the task at hand. And then, after what seemed like hours in the suffocating silence, there came a distinct click, different from the rest. [he] pauses, then gently turns the handle. The door of the safe swings open with a reluctant creak.

Slowly, [name]'s hands begin their dance around the dial, [his] ears listening for the subtlest of sounds. Minutes pass, stretching into tense hours, as [he] remains locked in a silent battle with the obstinate vault.


But despite [his] skill, the safe remains unyielding. No comforting click, no gratifying shift of mechanisms echos from within its steel walls. Each combination attempted only meets the same, disheartening silence. The dial spins, numbers blurring and dancing in [his] vision, but the safe offers no encouragement, no indication of progress.

eventOptions.title: Leave
eventOptions.description: You simply do not have the time to linger here for hours attempting to crack the safe.

eventActions.activationText: There is a quiet regret as you turn away, a mourning for the treasure left behind. The allure of the unopened safe is a siren's call you are forced to ignore, an opportunity lost to the pressing weight of time.

data.encounterText: Finally, the last of the fiery damned falls, its form collapsing into embers that quickly fade away. The Hell Coffer, once spinning with the force of a maelstrom, slows finally coming to a stop. A soft click echos as it unlocks, revealing its treasures to the victorious.

data.encounterText: Suspended above a stone pedestal is a Hell Coffer, an object of legend and fear. Encrusted with jagged obsidian and adorned with runes glowing as though forged in hellfire, the coffer is an infernal masterpiece. The stories whisper of such artifacts, constructs of the demonic realms where damned lords store their most precious possessions. The promise of the treasure it holds is an intoxicating allure to any mortal. Yet, it is a lure designed to ensnare the greedy and unwary, drawing them into a pact with powers they could hardly fathom.

eventOptions.title: Open
eventOptions.description: Attempt to loot the Hell Coffer.

eventActions.activationText:
You reach out and tentatively touch the surface of the Coffer.

The reaction is instantaneous. The coffer begins to spin, its dark light intensifying. From its depths, the damned rise, figures of pure flame and fury. Their cries of rage and hatred fill your mind, echoing out across the emberlands. You find yourself surrounded, the fiery figures advancing, their intentions clear and deadly.

eventOptions.title: Leave
eventOptions.description: Think better of falling for this devlish trap.

eventActions.activationText: Survival is a treasure far more precious than any gem, and to risk your life for mere riches, you knew, was a fool's gamble.

data.encounterText: You have defeated Lord Infernicus!
data.promptToSelectCharacter: Who if any will take his soul?

eventOptions.title: Claim
eventOptions.description: Take the Soul of Lord Infernicus.

data.encounterText: In a conflagration of heat and ash, a Hell Gate erupts into existence before you. Its molten edges twist and writhe, the stench of sulfur and brimstone filling the air. It casts a wicked light onto your face, painting the scene in hues of orange and red, flickering like the heart of a fire. Your heart pounds in your chest, adrenaline surging through your veins as you weigh your options. Flee and live, or stay and face whatever horror is to step from the fiery gateway.
data.promptToSelectCharacter: Who will listen to his pleas?

eventOptions.title: Wait
eventOptions.description: See what exits the portal to satisfy your curiosity.

eventActions.activationText:
Bravery, foolhardiness, or a mix of both holds you in place, your eyes never leaving the roiling gate. 

And then, with a final belch of flame and a concussive blast of heat, something does step through. Out from the Hell Gate comes the imposing figure of Lord Infernicus. Towering and monstrous, wreathed in flame, his eyes twin pools of molten lava. Yet, rather than the roar of a challenge, the thunderous voice rings out in confusion.

"Wrong turn,"he mutters as his gaze sweeps over the heroes, his confusion fading into resigned exasperation. "...Ah. Mortals. Why am I not surprised?"

Despite the dire circumstances, the sight of the formidable Lord Infernicus, fresh from a mismanaged gate transit, is almost comical. Almost.

eventOptions.title: Leave
eventOptions.description: No amount of curiosity can convince you wait around to see what exits this Infernal Portal.

eventActions.activationText: You allow your gripping fear to guide you along the safest, quickest route. You can hear the gate behind you, can feel the heat nipping at your heels like a hungry beast.

data.encounterText:
A magical reef, completely out of place on dry land, captures your attention instantly. It is as if a slice of the ocean was suddenly transported and dropped right here in front of you, held in place by an invisible tube of water.

Glowing fish swim around, their luminescent forms painting streaks of color against the murky backdrop. A plethora of coral structures jut out, splashing life onto this land-locked aquatic oasis. Your hand moves forward, pressing against the surface of the cone. The invisible barrier gives way, cool water enveloping your skin as your hand plunges into the underwater wonderland.

Then you spot it – whispers of treasure, glistening from within the underwater biome. The metallic gleam catching the ambient light from the glowing fish and turning it into a beacon calling you.
data.promptToSelectCharacter: Who will try and claim the treasure?

eventOptions.title: Claim
eventOptions.description: Swim towards the treasure.

eventActions.activationText:
[name] holds [his] breath, pushing through the barrier, [his] body fully embraced by the chilling water.


Swimming amidst the shoals of glowing fish, [name] moves deeper, chasing the glint of the treasure. [His] lungs start to burn, the need for air escalating with each stroke. But [he] presses on, the sight of the treasure tantalizingly close, spurring [him] forward.


Reaching out with an arm already chilled from the water, [his] fingers wrap around the treasure, its solid weight a comforting sensation.

Swimming through an intricate coral maze, [name]'s eyes fix on the gleaming item nestled at the very bottom. [His] lungs scream for oxygen, but [he] forces [him]self further, kicking [his] legs in a powerful stroke. But the currents play tricks, twisting and turning [him] around.


[He] is running out of air. Panic seizes [him] and [his] movements become more frantic. The treasure is just there - so close [he] can touch it - but [his] body is starting to revolt against the lack of oxygen. Regretfully, [he] relinquishes [his] pursuit of the treasure, [his] need for survival far exceeding [his] desire for riches.

data.encounterText: Victory was hard-won and bittersweet. The cavern floor is littered with fallen foes, and you bare numerous injuries. But you are alive, and have proven yourself against a horde of summoned enemies. You have faced the call of the battle and emerged victorious.

EventPrefabReference.Path: Island Hex Pieces\Events\Horn of Glorious Battle

eventActions.activationText: Victory has left you sharper, stronger, and  more experienced.

data.encounterText:
Resting upon an ancient stone plinth, you discover a horn, grand and ornate, that seems to sing with an unseen power. It is  enormous, constructed of what appeared to be bone or perhaps ivory, sheathed in fine metals and studded with twinkling jewels. Its dwarven craftsmanship is evident in the meticulous detailing, the intricate patterns that wound their way around the horn like a visual symphony.

You've heard tale of such horns of battle. Artifacts that summon allies when sounded... or enemies."
data.promptToSelectCharacter: Who will listen to his pleas?

EventPrefabReference.Path: Island Hex Pieces\Events\Horn of Glorious Battle

eventActions.activationText:
The sound that erupts is deep and rich, rolling across the landscape like a war drum. It echoes off the mountains, filling the air, the ground, your very bones with its call.


Then, silence. A heavy, waiting silence. The echoes of the horn call still ringing in your ears, but everything else seems eerily quiet. And then, you hear it. The steady march of war, the cry of battle, the clatter of armaments. The call has been answered.

eventOptions.title: Leave
eventOptions.description: The allure of the horn is powerful, but so is the dread of the unknown.

eventActions.activationText: With a final, lingering glance at the impressive artifact, you move away, leaving the horn untouched.

data.encounterText: Before you rests the burning skull of an infernal fiend. It's terrifying bone visage has been blackened by the flames that envelop it. As you approach a harsh voice enters your mind. Demon Skull: "Hello, mortal!" Demon Skull: "I am reluctant to admit that I am in need of some aid..." Demon Skull: "Perhaps we can help each other?! I need SOULS! And you need... loot and gold and such." Demon Skull: "Bring me along with you and I will take the souls of those monsters you defeat and in return I will give you TREASURE!"

eventOptions.title: Accept
eventOptions.description: Disregard all morals and place the hellish skull into your bags. Gain [o1a1_status].

eventActions.activationText: You accept. Demon Skull: "Yessss... I WILL FEAST UPON THEIR SOULS!"

eventOptions.title: Refuse
eventOptions.description: You think better of helping this soul hungry demon.

data.encounterText: Turn after turn, you anticipate the monstrous spring-loaded figure within to burst forth. Yet, the jack-in-the-box defies expectation. With each rotation, the melody continues, chilling your bones and testing your resolve, but the lid remains closed.
data.promptToSelectCharacter: Who will try and crack the Heavy Safe?

EventPrefabReference.Path: Island Hex Pieces\Events\Jack in the Box

eventOptions.title: Crank
eventOptions.description: Continue to turn the Crank.

eventActions.activationText: As the handle moves, the haunting melody plays, a chilling echo of a once innocent children's tune now twisted by its dark surroundings. The notes hang in the air, shrouded in an eerie suspense.

eventOptions.title: Leave
eventOptions.description: Give up on this twisted game.

eventActions.activationText:
As you move away, the silence shatters. A blast echoes through the castle as the jack-in-the-box explodes open, a riot of colorful confetti eruptes from its depths. Laughter, eerie and cruel, echoes through the halls as the figure within came into view. The Jack was no more.


In its place stands The Jester. A grotesque caricature of what was once a joyful figure, he wears a motley costume of bright colors, each piece patterned with mocking faces. His own face, disturbingly human, bares a twisted smile as his eyes gleam with cruel mirth. A demon in the garb of a clown, he had awaited your departure to reveal his true, horrifying nature, ready to play his wicked games with the trespassers who dared to disturb his rest.

data.encounterText: You have vanquished The Jester! The Paladin greets you: "You have done what I could not, Hero. You have brought an end to the evil that has twisted this kingdom." "Take this as a token of my gratitude, let it remind you that for every shadow in the dark, there lives a beacon of light to banish it."

eventOptions.description: Take The Paladin's gift.
